en.runTitle: Leeds: repair or replace a 6-year-old laptop within GBP 700

fields.label: Exact laptop model, processor and symptoms
fields.value: A 6-year-old Windows laptop that is slow and has a weak battery (model not known yet)

fields.label: Apps and workload
fields.value: Bookkeeping, invoices, video calls and light photo editing for social posts

fields.label: Battery life and portability
fields.placeholder: e.g. 6+ hours away from a desk, under 1.6 kg

fields.label: Windows compatibility result, storage used and repair quote
fields.placeholder: e.g. passes the Windows 11 check, 180 GB used, a shop quote of £150

en.template: Compare repairing my {laptop} with replacing it in {postcode} by {date}, within {budget}. I use {apps}, need {battery}, and have {checks}. Separate parts, labour, delivery, migration, backup and secure disposal; flag missing battery, charger and warranty details. Plan only; do not contact shops or buy anything.

phases.judgment: It would not promise a full-day battery for the refurbished ThinkPad: the 8h58 figure came from a review of a different, higher-spec version, so the guide tells you to check battery condition.

phases.title: Write the guide and dated source notes with a practical recommendation
Check the sources, the sums and the page layout, then deliver
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer caught that a fifth option, a Dell laptop, came to GBP 729 once backup and wiping allowances were added, and that was before its charger. It was taken off the shortlist rather than shown as a qualifying choice.
